name: mock-oxylabs
description: Mock Oxylabs residential proxy (pr.oxylabs.io:7777) for local tests. Standard HTTP proxy with Basic auth (customer-USER:PASS), per-request IP rotation simulated by random X-Forwarded-For header, forwards everything to https://boppy.me with Range/206 streaming preserved. Acts exactly like the real Oxylabs gateway except the actual IP isn't residential — it's the sandbox's IP.
